title: Gevrey Regularity and Compact Quantum Metric Spaces for $L^p$-Group Algebras
summary: We introduce the beta-Gevrey lp-rapid decay property (GRD){beta,p}, for 0 < beta <= 1 and 1 <= p < infinity, for countable discrete groups. This property is a subexponential analogue of classical rapid decay, in which polynomial control is replaced by logarithmic subexponential control of order o(R^beta). We establish basic results for (GRD){beta,p}. We then apply this framework to compact quantum metric structures on reduced Lp-group algebras.
